change_summary: NOAA NGOFS2 MODEL guidance changed materially from about -16/-39/+62/+161 m to +23/+102/+239/+110 m at 1/3/6/12 hours. Near-term transport reversed shoreward and 6-hour support strengthened; 12-hour guidance remains shoreward but weakened. This improves the transport setup but is not observed current or oxygen. Production opportunity increased to Point Clear 3-7% and Daphne/May Day 2-4%, still below 20%. The 18:06-18:09 CDT owner-camera cycle passed 6/6; Point Clear showed slight ripple and Montrose moderate chop, with no scoped biological or human Jubilee signal. Direct Grand Hotel and Fairhope checks at 18:26:34-18:26:59 CDT both advanced and were probably fresh; water showed light to moderate chop, with no searching, collecting, directed lights, concentrated bird feeding or repeated fish surfacing. Direct local bottom/contact-strip oxygen remains UNKNOWN. The notification gate is met for the material model-guidance change, not Jubilee confirmation.
